Jane — really appreciate the clear asks and the checklist.

Were excited to partner on a structured readiness path. Proposed quick plan from our side:
1) Week 0 (prep): share enablement syllabus + MOU draft for redlines
2) Week 1: Solution overview & deployment patterns (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
3) Week 2: Deep dive — runtime optimizations, caching, quantization profiles
4) Week 3: Troubleshooting, cost tuning, and SLO-driven operational playbooks
5) Week 4: Certification exam + hands-on lab (customer-facing runbook exercise)

I can take lead on the syllabus and the lab content; Camila will coordinate delivery logistics and trainer capacity. Marissa, looping you for channel enablement materials and partner portal access.

Im available Monday 14th 10am PT — lets lock that. If that works, Ill send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Rishi
